input.question: Why does a youtube video load faster than a gif?
input.ground_truth: So many trolls, and nobody got it right yet. GIFs weren't designed for animation. [Source (Look at Appendix D. Conventions)](_URL_0_). On the other hand, video was designed for animation. For this reason, in a GIF file, each frame is transmitted entirely, while in a video file, only the differences between frames are transmitted. Also, modern video formats use better compression than GIF, but that's not as important. (Disclaimer: I'm not highly knowledgeable about this topic and I may have got something wrong. But this is surely better than the other answers.).

Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why does a youtube video load faster than a gif?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you are trying to carry a big box of crayons to your friend. If you carry just one crayon at a time (like a gif), it takes a long, long time to give all the crayons. But if you put all the crayons in a big box and carry them together (like a YouTube video), you get there much faster! 

YouTube videos are like big boxes that your computer knows how to carry quickly. Gifs are like carrying each crayon one by one, which is slower. That’s why YouTube videos load faster than gifs!
